a: Alerts by app, radio or loudspeaker miss people without phones, signal, literacy or the right language.
Age, disability, care duties and distance decide who can reach shade, water or a cooling centre.
Without land, credit, contracts or savings, resting in the heat means losing the day’s income.
Women, migrants and people from excluded communities are often missing from the rooms where heat plans are made.

q: Who can reach care in time
a: A clinic that is far away, has no way to cool patients, or is open only while people are at work turns treatable heat illness into a death.
